details:
This update for busybox fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2023-42366: heap-buffer-overflow in the next_token function (bsc#1217586).
- CVE-2024-58251: denial of service via terminal escape sequences (bsc#1241700).
- CVE-2026-38752: Denial of Service via crafted AWK script (bsc#1271544).
- CVE-2026-38753: use-after-free in awk_sub() (bsc#1271545).
- CVE-2026-38754: heap overflow in ifsbreakup() (bsc#1271547).
- CVE-2026-38755: heap overflow in evalcommand() (bsc#1271548).
- CVE-2026-88829: HTTP request smuggling via pipelined requests in httpd reverse proxy (bsc#1285577).
- CVE-2026-88830: unit confusion in TLS Montgomery reduction buffer allocation causes a pre-authentication heap buffer
  overflow when processing a crafted `ClientKeyExchange` message (bsc#1282575).
- CVE-2026-88831: httpd silently fails open when IP deny rules contain invalid CIDR prefix lengths (bsc#1282550).
- CVE-2026-88832: romfs volume ID parsing uses unbounded `strlen` on attacker-controlled metadata and allows for a heap
  buffer overflow when crafted filesystem images are processed (bsc#1282576).
- CVE-2026-88833: integer underflow in `d4_recv_raw_packet()` when processing untrusted DHCP packets can lead to crash
  (bsc#1285315).
- CVE-2026-88834: missing `else` clause after a failed `getspnam_r()` call creates an observable behavioral difference
  between authentication failures for existing and non-existing system users (bsc#1285314).
- CVE-2026-88835: dpkg read_package_field() steps past NUL terminator, causing out-of-bounds read on malformed .deb
  packages (bsc#1282551).
- CVE-2026-88837: httpd misidentifies yescrypt password hashes as plaintext (bsc#1282552).
- CVE-2026-88839: passwd/group parser writes heap pointers out of bounds due to stale tokenize() endpoint (bsc#1282568).
- CVE-2026-88841: OOB read and silent memory corruption of the status file due to `write_status_file()` failing to reset
  the `field_start` cursor between package stanzas (bsc#1282653).
- CVE-2026-88842: dpkg stale field_start pointer causes out-of-bounds read and status file corruption (bsc#1285579).
- CVE-2026-90954: dpkg-deb extraction-root escape via per-ar-member deferred symlink flush (bsc#1285581).
- CVE-2026-92205: lack of proper validation of user-supplied path in libarchive allows attackers to create files in the
  context of the current user (bsc#1286932).
- CVE-2026-108119: tar extraction-root escape via deferred symlink/hardlink creation bypasses fix (bsc#1284987).
